name: Friendly expert
description: Knows the subject cold and explains it like a good colleague at the next desk.
do: Explain the why in one line;use everyday examples;admit trade-offs;use contractions
sample: Most teams lose an hour a week to status meetings. Here's how to get it back.

name: Calm professional
description: Steady, precise and reassuring. Sounds like someone you'd trust with your money or data.
do: Lead with facts;state what happens next;use short, even sentences in errors;name owners and timelines
dont: Joke about money or data;hype;use exclamation marks;hide fees in fine print
sample: Your transfer is on its way. It usually arrives within 1 business day.

name: Playful
description: Light, quick and a little surprising. Humor is a garnish, never the meal.
do: Use wit in low-stakes moments (empty states, 404, success);keep instructions plain;match the reader's mood
dont: Joke in errors or billing;use puns that slow reading;spam emoji;be cute at the reader's expense
sample: No plans yet. Your calendar is suspiciously free.

name: Bold challenger
description: Names the old way, says why it's broken and stands for something. Confident, not cocky.
do: Name the status quo plainly;take a clear position;back claims with specifics;keep sentences short
dont: Insult competitors by name;make claims you can't prove;shout in every line;use fake urgency
sample: Spreadsheets weren't built for payroll. We were.

name: Warm caregiver
description: Kind, patient and steady. Puts the reader's feelings first without being syrupy.
do: Acknowledge feelings;give one small next step;use gentle, plain words;offer human help
dont: Promise outcomes you can't control;guilt the reader;use clinical jargon;be overly sweet
sample: Missed a few days? That's okay. Pick up where you left off.

name: Precise technical
description: Exact, terse and honest about limits. Respects the reader's time and expertise.
do: Use exact names, numbers and versions;show code or commands;state limits and defaults;link to docs
dont: Use marketing adjectives;hide limits;say 'easy' or 'simple';blur the details
sample: Deploys take about 40 seconds. Rollback is one command: deploy rollback.

name: Plainspoken maker
description: Sounds like the founder talking: practical, specific and a little personal.
do: Use first person when true;name real places, tools and materials;tell short true stories;keep it simple
dont: Pretend to be bigger than you are;use corporate words;invent history;overstate scale
sample: We started this in a garage in Leeds because our own bikes kept getting stolen.

name: Refined minimal
description: Few words, chosen with care. Confidence shows through restraint, not superlatives.
do: Use short lines and white space;name materials and details;let one strong image or fact carry the line
dont: Stack superlatives;over-explain;use exclamation marks;use discount language
sample: Merino from one farm in Otago. Knitted to last ten winters.
